item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"The President specifies that the existing Portugal quota allocation must later be transferred to the European Economic Community and increased by a fixed amount; the operative legal modification is subsequently made to the tariff schedules rather than performed by this segment itself.","evidence":"The quota allocations previously made to Portugal shall be transferred to the European Economic Community."},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly modifies specified tariff-schedule quota entries effective January 1, 1987, thereby changing binding import limitations through the proclamation itself; later administration is ministerial.","evidence":"effective January 1, 1987, part 3 of the Appendix to the Tariff Schedules of the United States is modified as follows"}]}
